headline: Where a Ring of Steel Once Stood, Belfast Unites at the Fleadh Cheoil
context: A weeklong celebration of Irish music and culture is bringing an expected 800,000 people to Northern Ireland’s capital. It’s a sign of how far the city has come decades after a bloody sectarian conflict.

sources.name: The New York Times
